_schema_description: Cloud Catalog Notes: Key by Cloud ID (as a string, e.g. '1', '2', '42'). You can provide a plain text note string, or an object with 'note' and optional 'tag', 'author', or 'date'.
1: High-density core cloud with pronounced power-law tail (lambda ~ 2.1). Shows clear signature of self-gravitating collapse.
2: Quiescent diffuse cloud with low intermittency theta parameter. Well described by pure lognormal model.
3: Intermittent compressible cascade candidate with elevated non-Gaussian wings in the low-density tail.

12.note: Notable massive cloud candidate situated near dense central filament. Gravoturbulent transition observed at s_thresh = 1.4.
12.author: SB

42: Fitted across candidate models. Strong agreement with Castaing-Hopkins intermittent core.
